input: A team wiki with real-time collaborative editing, version history, and per-workspace permissions. Around 500 users at launch.

suitability.reason: The workflow contains a sequencing error and a scope omission. The Infrastructure & Deployment task (Task-9) only depends on the Real-time Collaboration Server (Task-4), which schedules deployment before the frontend, main APIs, and versioning systems are built. Additionally, while there is a backend task for permissions, there is no frontend interface task for managing workspace permissions, which is a core requirement of the project.
suitability.suggestedWorkflow:
1. Database Schema Design: Design schemas for users, workspaces, pages, permissions, and document versions.
2. Authentication & User Management: Implement backend authentication and role-based access control.
3. Workspace & Permission APIs: Create backend services to manage workspaces, pages, and user permissions.
4. Real-time Collaboration Server: Set up a WebSocket/signaling server (e.g., Yjs or ShareDB) for concurrent editing.
5. Document Versioning Backend: Build services to save snapshots, compute diffs, and restore versions.
6. Frontend Shell & Navigation: Build the main layout, workspace switcher, and page navigation tree.
7. Workspace & Permissions UI: Create interfaces for managing workspace settings, inviting users, and assigning permissions.
8. Collaborative Rich-Text Editor: Integrate a collaborative editor on the frontend connected to the real-time server.
9. Version History UI: Develop the frontend interface to view document history, compare diffs, and perform rollbacks.
10. End-to-End Testing & Integration: Conduct integration testing for real-time sync, permissions, and versioning.
11. Infrastructure & Deployment: Configure production hosting, database provisioning, and WebSocket scaling for 500+ users, depending on all completed frontend and backend tasks.
suitability.suggestedSummary: A comprehensive 11-step workflow that adds a dedicated workspace permissions UI, ensures proper sequential integration testing, and positions the deployment phase at the end of the development lifecycle.
